scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const html=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8');for(const route of ['ai','ai/login','ai/dashboard','ai/interview/new','ai/history','ai/pricing','ai/account','ai/support']){const dir=path.join('dist',route);fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'index.html'),html)}"
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
